comment: Data Refresh Policy configuration. Defaults preserve existing ETL behaviour exactly: all stages enabled+required, weather chunk size 1000 (=weather_etl.INSERT_CHUNK_SIZE), incremental weather OFF.
failure_policy: continue-on-stage-failure (same as main_etl.py): remaining stages still run; exit code is non-zero if any REQUIRED stage did not finish SUCCESS.

weather_incremental.comment: When enabled, fetches weather from (per-airport watermark - overlap_days) instead of full flight history. OFF by default: existing full-range upsert behaviour is preserved. Watermarks are written only after a successful stage + verification.
